title: Freddie Mac MBS Disclosure Intelligence
summary: Verified governed issuance analytics with an implementation-ready Power BI roadmap for disclosure trust, balance and prepayment, credit and collateral, concentration, and investigation decisions.
scope: Implemented through M3: issuance, composition, schema control, reconciled quality/provenance, aggregate release, and value-free source intake. M5-M9: metric engine, certified Power BI model, nontechnical dashboard, investigation workflow, and semantic API. AI, private cloud, and publication remain separately gated.
